### Problem

The review's score can reward an invented finding and an easy clean set, so it does not show whether the review finds bugs.

### Scope

- evals/review/cases.json and baseline.json, scripts/review-eval.py (or evals.py's review step), scripts/review-outcomes.py, with `--test` cases.

### Out of scope

- The review's prompt.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the review set, when it is validated, then every flag case's line was changed by the commit that fixed it, and a case that was not is refused by its name.
- C2: Given a review that flags a different line of the same file, when it is scored, then the case counts as missed.
- C3: Given the set's run, when it is scored, then it holds at least 10 flag and 10 clean cases, plays each 3 times and scores the median.

### Criticality

Normal
